import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/emicro-deps');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from lark import Lark
from syntax import parse_policy,PolicyError
grammar = r'''
start: policy*
policy: predicate action ";"
?predicate: "(" predicate "and" predicate ")" -> and_
          | "(" predicate "or" predicate ")" -> or_
          | "not" "(" predicate ")" -> not_
          | atom
?atom: "match" "(" ph ")" -> match
     | "startswith" "(" ph ")" -> startswith
     | "endswith" "(" ph ")" -> endswith
     | "contains" "(" ph ")" -> contains
ph: [IDENT ("," IDENT)*]
action: "allow" -> allow
      | "drop" -> drop
IDENT: /[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23}/
%import common.WS
%ignore WS
'''
L=Lark(grammar,parser='lalr',maybe_placeholders=False)
# only these make <=4 distinct nonmatch, paths <=4 services
atoms=['match(A)','match(B)','match()','match(allow)','match(A,B)',
 'startswith(A)','startswith()','endswith(B,A)','contains(A,B)','contains(B)']

 if d>=4 or random.random()<.65:return random.choice(atoms)

 return '('+pred(d+1)+' '+k+' '+pred(d+1)+')'

  except Exception as e:print('ourerr',e)

 if i%2==0 and s:
